newsitem.title: UK: Roxboro sees year profits below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Roxboro sees year profits below expectations.

text.p: UK instrumentation and specialist components firm Roxboro Group Plc said on Friday it expected its profits for the year to be below market expectations, citing low demand levels for some of its products.
The firm said that based on trading in September and October, it saw no immediate prospect of a meaningful recovery in demand levels at its Dialight Electronics Product Group.

The company said preliminary conclusions of its study into the matter indicated that Electronics Product Group was suffering from weak overall demand for electronic components across the U.S. market and the prolonged de-stocking by customers and distributors.
Roxboro said trading in all of the other businesses of the group was in line with expectations, with improved margins at Weston Aerospace.

"The board remains confident of the fundamental prospects for both a recovery in demand at Electronic Products in the medium term and in the strength of the other businesses of the group," the company said.
